item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Many are in mourning as news of Coach Lou Holtz's passing has been shared by his family.

item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- La Casa de Amistad held their third annual Community Breakfast which drew in over 200 attendees including Jason Critchlow and Mansour Eid.

item.title: Notre Dame fans remember an Irish legend
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Notre Dame fans young and old gathered at The Linebacker Wednesday night to swap stories and raise a glass to former Notre Dame head coach Lou Holtz, who's family confirmed the Irish legend passed away at the age of 89. Holtz won 100 games for the blue & gold during his time in South Bend, and fans remember him as a hugely impactful figure for the school and the region.

item.title: Microsoft taxes to benefit LaPorte city and schools
item.description: LA PORTE, Ind. — La Porte leaders say each Data Center project coming to the area is different, but they are confident Microsoft will be a good partner.

item.title: Residents organize against proposed Meijer development in Niles Township
item.description: NILES TOWNSHIP, Ind. -- Some residents in Niles Township are organizing an opposition group to a proposed development that could bring a Meijer store and other commercial construction to the intersection of Niles-Buchanan Road and Morris Drive.

item.title: Downtown South Bend announces 'Disney Downtown' First Fridays event for March
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Downtown South Bend announced Wednesday that its First Fridays event for March is "Disney Downtown", with princess meet-and-greets, food specials, sing-alongs, and other themed activities prepared for Friday from 5 to 9 p.m.

item.title: South Bend Spring Artisan Market returns Saturday
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The South Bend Spring Artisan Market is returning to downtown South Bend Saturday and Sunday at the Century Center.

item.title: Man arrested for Intent to Deliver Meth after fleeing at 80 mph
item.description: VAN BUREN COUNTY, Mich. -- The Van Buren County Sheriff announced the arrest of a 58-year-old man Wednesday with charges including Possession with Intent to Deliver Methamphetamine.
